findings.description: Increased plans have been filed to replace the vacant theatre on this 0.56-acre corner site at Vicente Street with a twelve-storey, 156-foot mixed-use building: 172 rental apartments, 26 of them deed-restricted as affordable, over ground-floor retail and a basement garage, totalling about 269,520 square feet. The filing adds three floors and more than a hundred units to the previous scheme by taking in the adjacent property at 59 West Portal Avenue, which would also be demolished, and by using the city's Family Zoning plan, AB 1287 and SB 423. The ground floor is to incorporate a partially preserved facade from the theatre and a historicized copy of the decoration at 59–61 West Portal Avenue. No cost or construction timeline has been given. This is a proposal, so its team stays here and does not go into the page's building fields.

findings.description: The Planning Commission was due to hear a re-submission for a seven-storey, 29-unit mixed-use building here on 3 September 2026, replacing a vacant two-storey structure. The only significant change from the scheme already approved is its re-entitlement under the Housing Choice San Francisco program.

raw.text: San Francisco's Planning Commission will meet tomorrow and discuss proposed plans for a new 7-story apartment building located at 2051 Market Street.

publish.note: A hearing on next week's calendar is not something that happened at the building, and the headline — which is the whole entry — says only that a meeting is scheduled. The project was already approved once; nothing was decided, filed or built here. The filing itself, or the decision when it comes, would earn an entry, and 85 West Portal Avenue in the same batch is the difference: there, plans were filed.
